theca.definition:
n. a case or sheath especially a pollen sac or moss capsule
n. outer sheath of the pupa of certain insects
theca.translation:
n. 囊, 膜, 鞘
[医] 膜, 鞘

thecacells.translation: 泡膜细胞; 卵泡膜细胞

thecae.definition:
n a case or sheath especially a pollen sac or moss capsule
n outer sheath of the pupa of certain insects

thecal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a theca; as, a thecal abscess.

thecal whitlow.translation: [医] 腱鞘瘭疽(手指末节化脓性腱鞘炎)

thecaphore.definition:
n. A surface or organ bearing a theca, or covered with
   thecae.
n. See Basigynium.

thecasporous.definition: a. Having the spores in thecae, or cases.
thecasporous.translation: 子囊孢子的, 具子囊孢子的

thecial.translation: 子囊层或产囊子实层内生的

thecla.definition:
n. Any one of many species of small delicately colored
   butterflies belonging to Thecla and allied genera; -- called also
   hairstreak, and elfin.

thecodine.translation: 二羟可待因, 蒂可定

thecodont.definition: n presumably in the common ancestral line to dinosaurs and crocodiles and birds
thecodont.translation: a. 有槽齿的,槽齿类的

thecodontia.definition:
n. pl. A group of fossil saurians having biconcave
   vertebrae and the teeth implanted in sockets.

thecodontian.translation: a. 有槽齿的,槽齿类的

thecodontians.translation: (thecodontian 的复数) adj.有槽齿的,槽齿类的

thecodonts.definition:
plural of thecodont
n presumably in the common ancestral line to dinosaurs and crocodiles and birds
thecodonts.translation: (thecodont 的复数) adj.有槽齿的,槽齿类的

thecosoma.translation: [医] 裂体吸虫属, 血吸虫属

thecosomata.definition:
n. pl. An order of Pteropoda comprising those species
   which have a shell. See Pteropoda.
